run_spm_encode_pieces: run spm_encode.py to encode input text files into SentencePiece token pieces using a model
run_spm_encode_ids: run spm_encode.py to encode input text files into SentencePiece token IDs using a model
run_spm_encode_with_length_filter: run spm_encode.py with --min-len and --max-len to filter lines by token count
run_spm_encode_stdin: run spm_encode.py to encode text piped via stdin and write encoded output to stdout
run_spm_encode_parallel_files: run spm_encode.py to encode multiple input files in parallel with matching output files
